# watchpoint_kubernetes_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up the cluster monitor created when a Watchpoint Kubernetes operator enrolled, by the `clusterName` the operator was installed with. Use its `id` wherever a monitor id is taken, for example `watchpoint_monitor_policy`. Requires the `kubernetes_operator` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The cluster monitor created when the operator was installed with
# clusterName=prod-eu, filed under the platform team.
data "watchpoint_kubernetes_cluster" "prod_eu" {
  cluster_name = "prod-eu"
}

resource "watchpoint_monitor_policy" "prod_eu" {
  monitor_id     = data.watchpoint_kubernetes_cluster.prod_eu.id
  owner_group_id = watchpoint_user_group.platform.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name the operator was installed with (Helm `clusterName`).

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the enrolled operator that reports for this cluster.
- `alert_profile_id` (String) Alert profile attached to the monitor.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group the monitor belongs to.
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `name` (String) Monitor name, `Kubernetes: <cluster_name>` unless renamed.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to the monitor.
- `status` (String) `Active`, `Paused`, or `Disabled` once the operator is removed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on the monitor. Unordered.
